info.name: SoundCloud — Ember Orange Dark Magenta Glow v2.4
info.description:
A firelit dark theme for SoundCloud, blending warm ember-orange typography and branding with cinematic plum backgrounds, electric magenta accents, violet highlights, and glowing interaction states.

Includes coordinated hover halos for navigation and menus, orange-glow playback buttons, magenta-highlighted track rows, vivid dropdowns, and an optional CSS-only waveform-style bottom player. The waveform pattern follows SoundCloud's existing progress width; it is a visual texture rather than a waveform generated from the audio itself.
